lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachee preet ham tum siu joree ||
lines.translation: I am joined in true love with You, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tum siu jor avar sa(n)g toree ||3||
lines.translation: I am joined with You, and I have broken with all others. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਜਾਉ ਤਹਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah jah jaau tahaa teree sevaa ||
lines.translation: Wherever I go, there I serve You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: tum so thaakur aur na devaa ||4||
lines.translation: There is no other Lord Master than You, O Divine Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਭਜਨ ਕਟਹਿ ਜਮ ਫਾਂਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumare bhajan katahi jam phaa(n)saa ||
lines.translation: Meditating, vibrating upon You, the noose of death is cut away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat het gaavai ravidaasaa ||5||5||
lines.translation: To attain devotional worship, Ravi Daas sings to You, Lord. ||5||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਪਵਨ ਕਾ ਥੰਭਾ ਰਕਤ ਬੁੰਦ ਕਾ ਗਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal kee bheet pavan kaa tha(n)bhaa rakat bu(n)d kaa gaaraa ||
lines.translation: The body is a wall of water, supported by the pillars of air; the egg and sperm are the mortar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਡ ਮਾਸ ਨਾੜਂੀ ਕੋ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਸੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: haad maas naaRa(n)ee ko pi(n)jar pa(n)khee basai bichaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: The framework is made up of bones, flesh and veins; the poor soul-bird dwells within it. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: praanee kiaa meraa kiaa teraa ||
lines.translation: O mortal, what is mine, and what is yours?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਰਵਰ ਪੰਖਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise taravar pa(n)kh baseraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The soul is like a bird perched upon a tree. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕੰਧ ਉਸਾਰਹੁ ਨੀਵਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: raakhahu ka(n)dh usaarahu neevaa(n) ||
lines.translation: You lay the foundation and build the walls.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਢੇ ਤੀਨਿ ਹਾਥ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੀਵਾਂ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saadhe teen haath teree seevaa(n) ||2||
lines.translation: But in the end, three and a half cubits will be your measured space. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਕੇ ਬਾਲ ਪਾਗ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)ke baal paag sir deree ||
lines.translation: You make your hair beautiful, and wear a stylish turban on your head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਭਸਮ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ihu tan hoigo bhasam kee dheree ||3||
lines.translation: But in the end, this body shall be reduced to a pile of ashes. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ooche ma(n)dar su(n)dar naaree ||
lines.translation: Your palaces are lofty, and your brides are beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin baajee haaree ||4||
lines.translation: But without the Lord's Name, you shall lose the game entirely. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਕਮੀਨੀ ਪਾਂਤਿ ਕਮੀਨੀ ਓਛਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: meree jaat kameenee paa(n)t kameenee ochhaa janam hamaaraa ||
lines.translation: My social status is low, my ancestry is low, and my life is wretched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਚੰਦ ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: tum saranaagat raajaa raam cha(n)d kahi ravidaas chamaaraa ||5||6||
lines.translation: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Luminous Lord, my King; so says Ravi Daas, the shoemaker. ||5||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਮਰਟਾ ਗਾਂਠਿ ਨ ਜਨਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: chamarataa gaa(n)th na janaee ||
lines.translation: I am a shoemaker, but I do not know how to mend shoes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਗੁ ਗਠਾਵੈ ਪਨਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: log gathaavai panahee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: People come to me to mend their shoes. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਰ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਹ ਤੋਪਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aar nahee jih topau ||
lines.translation: I have no awl to stitch them;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਰਾਂਬੀ ਠਾਉ ਰੋਪਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nahee raa(n)bee thaau ropau ||1||
lines.translation: I have no knife to patch them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਗੁ ਗੰਠਿ ਗੰਠਿ ਖਰਾ ਬਿਗੂਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: log ga(n)th ga(n)th kharaa bigoochaa ||
lines.translation: Mending, mending, people waste their lives and ruin themselves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਾਂਠੇ ਜਾਇ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hau bin gaa(n)the jaai pahoochaa ||2||
lines.translation: Without wasting my time mending, I have found the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਜਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ravidaas japai raam naamaa ||
lines.translation: Ravi Daas chants the Lord's Name;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੩॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: mohi jam siu naahee kaamaa ||3||7||
lines.translation: he is not concerned with the Messenger of Death. ||3||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਭੀਖਨ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag sorath baanee bhagat bheekhan kee ||
lines.translation: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Bheekhan Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਹੈ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਨਾ ਭਏ ਕੇਸ ਦੁਧ ਵਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nainahu neer bahai tan kheenaa bhae kes dudh vaanee ||
lines.translation: Tears well up in my eyes, my body has become weak, and my hair has become milky-white.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂਧਾ ਕੰਠੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਉਚਰੈ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: roodhaa ka(n)th sabad nahee ucharai ab kiaa karahi paraanee ||1||
lines.translation: My throat is tight, and I cannot utter even one word; what can I do now? I am a mere mortal. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੋਹਿ ਬੈਦ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam raai hohi baid banavaaree ||
lines.translation: O Lord, my King, Gardener of the world-garden, be my Physician,

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੰਤਹ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: apane sa(n)tah lehu ubaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: and save me, Your Saint. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਥੇ ਪੀਰ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਜਲਨਿ ਹੈ ਕਰਕ ਕਰੇਜੇ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maathe peer sareer jalan hai karak kareje maahee ||
lines.translation: My head aches, my body is burning, and my heart is filled with anguish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਬੇਦਨ ਉਪਜਿ ਖਰੀ ਭਈ ਵਾ ਕਾ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aisee bedan upaj kharee bhaee vaa kaa aukhadh naahee ||2||
lines.translation: Such is the disease that has struck me; there is no medicine to cure it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਗਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam a(n)mrit jal niramal ihu aukhadh jag saaraa ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, the ambrosial, immaculate water, is the best medicine in the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਭੀਖਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad kahai jan bheekhan paavau mokh duaaraa ||3||1||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, says servant Bheekhan, I have found the Door of Salvation. ||3||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa naam ratan niramolak pu(n)n padaarath paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Such is the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the invaluable jewel, the most sublime wealth, which I have found through good deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਰਤਨੁ ਨ ਛਪੈ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anik jatan kar hiradai raakhiaa ratan na chhapai chhapaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: By various efforts, I have enshrined it within my heart; this jewel cannot be hidden by hiding it. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਹਤੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun kahate kahan na jaaee ||
lines.translation: The Glorious Praises of the Lord cannot be spoken by speaking.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਗੂੰਗੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise goo(n)ge kee mithiaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: They are like the sweet candies given to a mute. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਾ ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa ramat sunat sukh sravanaa chit chete sukh hoee ||
lines.translation: The tongue speaks, the ears listen, and the mind contemplates the Lord; they find peace and comfort.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਭੀਖਨ ਦੁਇ ਨੈਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu bheekhan dui nain sa(n)tokhe jah dekhaa(n) tah soee ||2||2||
lines.translation: Says Bheekhan, my eyes are content; wherever I look, there I see the Lord. ||2||2||
